comment: 'Occulomotor' typo; trigeminocardiac reflex via trigeminal nerve, C correct.
Stem truncated at 'Rho', remainder pushed into option E; key A (polycythemia) wrong, RhD antibodies (G) is correct.
'Gamteocyte' typo for gametocyte; hypnozoite clearly correct.
'Aspaic acid' typo for aspartic acid; arginine positively charged at physiological pH.
Run-on stem without punctuation, still understandable; complete hemogram is best first investigation.
'coccidionnycosis' misspelled; pseudohyphae and chlamydospores indicate candidiasis.
Stem is a fragment 'Feed forward mechanism..' but intent clear; anticipatory salivation is feedforward.
'hea rate'/'hea beat' typos in distractors; D is correct APGAR expansion.
'foified' typo for fortified; health education is health promotion, not specific protection.
Option '259' garbled; mean minus 2 SD gives 28, only plausible option as written.
'Corlicospinal' typo; lateral spinothalamic tract carries pain and temperature.
'Material' typo for maternal in A and B; chorionic villus biopsy is diagnostic, D correct.
'H lar' typo for hilar; waxing-waning jaundice with double-duct sign fits periampullary carcinoma.
'detion' and '10P' garbled; stem asks population range but key uses mean +/-2 SE; C only computable option.
'aerial' typo for arterial; polypoidal choroidal vasculopathy does not cause optic atrophy.
'which pa' and 'Myentric' typos; slow waves originate in interstitial cells of Cajal.
'soft plate' typo for palate (also 'RubeLlla'); vesicles on soft palate/pharynx = herpangina.
'Following a A' (RTA) and 'Sta'/'mid' garbled; PRBC first, platelets at room temperature still best.
'Her daughter' inconsistent with neonate as subject; physiologic withdrawal bleeding, reassurance correct.
Options B and D duplicated 'Upper 1st premolar'; lower first premolar lingual cusp is non-functional, A unaffected.
'Autoinnoculation' misspelled; papilloma (HPV) shows autoinoculation.
Stem has redundant trailing 'is'; crater is most common osseous defect.
'bladderv' typo in distractor; stroke causes uninhibited neurogenic bladder.
'Dale' is the eponym (Dale's vasomotor reversal), not garbled 'dilation'; only lowercase. B correct.
Many nonexistent fibre types (III-VII) as padding; claim that IIX is nonstandard is false. IIb is a near-synonym but IIx best.
'tectorial ligaments' and 'transverse...membranes' sloppy wording; does not change keyed option I.
'Corona]' stray bracket; sagittal synostosis causes scaphocephaly.
Not contradictory: OA with distal TEF plus duodenal atresia gives double bubble; urgent TEF ligation correct.
Options corrupted to dates ('3-Jan','10-May','15-Oct'); keyed option C unreadable as written. Claim on D wrong.
'children aged admitted' missing age value; abstract states QT changes increased arrhythmia, yes.
Stem 'Kroll designed' is a fragment; Krol's RPI clasp system, A correct.
'do not break' describes tense bullae of bullous pemphigoid, not 'blanch'; linear IgG correct.
'Bacteroids' misspelling of Bacteroides; still correct keyed answer.
'aerial' typo for arterial; low pCO2 with pH 7.45 = compensated respiratory alkalosis.
'acts which of' missing 'with'/'via'; heparin acts through antithrombin III.
'trapezium muscle' misnomer for trapezius; each trapezius is triangular, though 'Trapezium' option is a tempting distractor.
Option E is a deliberately false distractor, not a source error; F correct.
'leve' and 'polyglonal' typos in distractors; osteolytic lesions correct.
'Solicocephaly' nonexistent (maybe scoliocephaly, a plagiocephaly synonym); plagiocephaly still best.
'hearing toss inosto' garbled; noise-induced hearing loss affects outer hair cells.
'Pick out odd drugs...are' ungrammatical; amoxicillin is the odd one out.
Sentence-completion stem; options complete 'to the'. Probing depth to apical penetration of probe, D correct.
'III. Hypothesis' lacks name; key D excludes III, so answer unaffected.
'Vescicovaginal' misspelled; stress incontinence from urethral hypermobility correct.
'flexor' is intentional (antagonist hamstrings). Reciprocal inhibition is Ia -> interneuron -> alpha (H), so key E wrong.
'21-year-old old' duplicated word; psychosis beyond mood episodes = schizoaffective.
'Coisone' garbled cortisol; among options cortisol best (DHEA-S not offered).
'detecting N. gonorrhoeae in penicillin' reversed; meant penicillinase detection, nitrocefin correct.
'half detected (sensitivity 37%)' and '74.4% (49%)' inconsistent; yes vs maybe is debatable.
'coex' typo. Brown fat is interscapular, so scapula contains it; subcutaneous tissue (B) better answer.
'factor 4 Leiden' should be factor V; near-syncope on micturition = situational syncope.
Option B garbled ('but any relation'); also F (no jaundice, raised ammonia) is true for Reye, competing with I.
'dries mucous membranes' typo for dry; Sjogren carries non-Hodgkin lymphoma risk.
'Tofacitinab' misspelled; tofacitinib avoided given age, CV disease, dyslipidemia.
Stem asks 'shape' while giving shape; options are crystal types; notched plates = cholesterol.
